title: Application Insights, autoscale and DCR Event Hub field schema catalogue
scope: All 22 requested labels, including seven Application Insights aliases, represented by 15 canonical diagnostic categories.
notes: App* columns are published Log Analytics definitions; exact Event Hub field casing, nesting and serialization remain unverified.
Alias entries use schema_ref to avoid duplicating the canonical field dictionary.
Standard Log Analytics columns are separated and must not be required in raw Event Hub payloads.
Allow missing, null and additional fields.
This is a reference catalogue, not a strict JSON Schema validator.

event_hub_envelope.basis: Azure Monitor common resource-log specification; validate per category

fields.name: category_or_type
fields.note: The common specification identifies type as the category field for Application Insights exports. Validate actual messages; do not require category alone.

event_hub_envelope.batch_handling: Process each records[] item when present; actual message framing must be validated.

ingestion_guidance: Deduplicate alias names before configuring exports.
Use resourceId with category or type to identify the schema.
Preserve correlation fields such as OperationId and ParentId where supplied.
Treat Properties, Measurements and other dynamic fields as structured or variably serialized content until inspected.
Keep event time and Event Hub receipt times separately.
verification_command: az monitor diagnostic-settings categories list --resource "<resource-id>" --output json
